usageNotes: Use this to verify that the QEMU Guest Agent (qemu-guest-agent) is running and responsive inside a VM without disrupting the guest or its workloads. The VM must be powered on and the guest agent service must be installed and started — the call will fail with an error if the agent is not available. Returns immediately with an object containing a `result` property; there is no async UPID.

examples.summary: Ping the guest agent on VM 101 running on node pve1

tips: A successful response (non-error) confirms the guest agent channel is open; use it as a health-check before issuing agent write commands.
If the call returns an error such as 'No QEMU guest agent configured', the agent package is missing or the service is stopped inside the guest.
Requires VM.GuestAgent.Audit OR VM.GuestAgent.Unrestricted on /vms/{vmid} — read-only audit privilege is sufficient.
